title: 听力挑战 · 职场谈判

rounds.speaker: 我方代表
rounds.line: We appreciate your proposal, but we believe the current price exceeds the budget that our department has allocated.
rounds.lineCn: 我们感谢贵方的方案,但我们认为目前的价格超出了我们部门分配的预算。

grammar.name: 委婉拒绝句式
grammar.note: We appreciate... but... 先肯定再转折,是谈判中礼貌表达难处的常用框架;exceeds the budget 是超预算的标准搭配。

options.text: The current price is above the department budget.
options.feedback: 对方指出价格超出了部门预算。

options.text: The current price is far below the budget limit.
options.feedback: 价格是超出预算,而非低于预算。

options.text: The proposal has been rejected without any discussion.
options.feedback: 对方先肯定方案,再商谈价格问题。

rounds.speaker: 对方代表
rounds.line: If you could offer a discount of ten percent, we would be willing to sign the contract this week.
rounds.lineCn: 如果贵方能提供百分之十的折扣,我们愿意本周签订合同。

grammar.name: 条件让步谈判句式
grammar.note: If you could... we would be willing to... 是虚拟语气条件句,提出条件以换取承诺,谈判关键句式。

options.text: A ten percent discount would make them sign the contract this week.
options.feedback: 给出九折优惠,对方就愿本周签约。

options.text: No discount can possibly change their decision.
options.feedback: 对方明确表示折扣能促成签约。

options.text: The contract will not be signed until next year.
options.feedback: 满足条件后本周即可签约。

rounds.speaker: 我方代表
rounds.line: We are flexible on the delivery date, provided that the quality standards are strictly maintained.
rounds.lineCn: 我们对交货日期可以灵活处理,前提是质量标准必须严格执行。

grammar.name: 灵活妥协的表达
grammar.note: be flexible on 表在...上有弹性;provided that 引导前提条件,是谈判中给出让步的典型句式。

options.text: The delivery date is negotiable if quality standards are met.
options.feedback: 质量有保障的前提下,日期可以商量。

options.text: The delivery date cannot be changed under any circumstances.
options.feedback: 我方对日期是灵活的,可以调整。

options.text: Quality standards are not important in this deal.
options.feedback: 质量标准正是谈判的前提条件。

rounds.speaker: 对方代表
rounds.line: Let me summarize our position: we need faster delivery, a lower price, and better after-sales service.
rounds.lineCn: 让我总结一下我们的立场:我们需要更快的交货、更低的价格和更好的售后服务。

grammar.name: 总结立场句式
grammar.note: Let me summarize our position 是谈判中总结要点的过渡句;三个并列名词短语清晰列出诉求。

options.text: They demand quicker delivery, lower price, and better service.
options.feedback: 对方的三点诉求:快交货、低价格、优售后。

options.text: They demand a higher price for better quality.
options.feedback: 诉求是更低价格,而非涨价。

options.text: They only care about the product packaging.
options.feedback: 诉求涉及交货、价格和售后,与包装无关。

rounds.speaker: 我方代表
rounds.line: I think we have reached a consensus, so let us prepare the final agreement and send it to both parties.
rounds.lineCn: 我认为我们已经达成共识,那么让我们准备最终协议并发送给双方吧。

grammar.name: 达成共识的表达
grammar.note: reach a consensus 是达成一致的固定搭配;prepare the final agreement 是收尾行动,标志谈判成功结束。

options.text: Both sides have agreed, and the final agreement will be prepared.
options.feedback: 双方已达成共识,即将准备最终协议。

options.text: The negotiation ended without any agreement.
The final agreement will never be sent to the parties.
options.feedback: 协议准备完毕后将发给双方。
